val: Jūsu atkopšanas frāze atjauno katru kontu katrā tīklā. Izturieties pret to kā pret seifa atslēgām.

key: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.
en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.
val: Jūsu atkopšanas frāze paliek jūsu. Ar to varat atkārtoti importēt šo maku — servera nav, un tās noņemšana šeit nezaudē neko, ko esat pierakstījis.

key: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
val: Jūsu atkopšanas frāze paliek jūsu. Ar to varat atkārtoti importēt šo maku — servera nav, un tās noņemšana šeit nezaudē neko, ko esat pierakstījis.

key: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
en: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
val: Jūsu atkopšanas frāze tika šifrēta jūsu ierīcē ar jūsu izvēlētu paroli. Tikai šī šifrētā kopija atrodas jūsu privātajā iCloud — Apple un Aperture nekad nevar to nolasīt.

key: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
val: Jūsu atkopšanas frāze ir pārbaudīta, un atslēgas tagad ir aizsargātas šajā ierīcē.

key: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.
en: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.

key: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
en: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
val: Jūsu maka vēsture, kontaktpersonas, kešatmiņā saglabātie atlikumi un portfeļa momentuzņēmumi.

key: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
en: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: Jūsu maks atrodas tikai šajā iPhone tālrunī. Ja jūsu iPhone tiks pazaudēts, salūzīs vai izdzēsts, jūsu maks — un viss tajā — būs pazudis. Atkopšanas frāze ir vienīgais ceļš atpakaļ.

key: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
en: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
val: Jūsu maks ir gatavs. Dublējiet savu atkopšanas frāzi, lai vēlāk varētu to atjaunot, ja pazaudēsit šo ierīci.

key: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
en: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
val: Jūsu maks ir gatavs. Atlikumi un aktivitātes tiks parādītas, kad tīkli tiks atsvaidzināti.

key: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
val: Jūsu maks tika veiksmīgi izveidots un ir gatavs lietošanai.

key: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
val: Jūsu maks tika veiksmīgi importēts un ir gatavs lietošanai.

key: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
en: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
val: Jūsu pierakstītā frāze ir vienīgā kopija. Aperture tās kopijas nav — glabājiet to drošībā.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
val: Jūsu piekļuves kods atbloķē Aperture un aizsargā šī iPhone jūsu maku kopiju.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
val: Jūsu piekļuves kods atbloķē Aperture. %@ ir ātrāks īsinājumtaustiņš uz to pašu slēdzeni — jūs vienmēr varat atgriezties pie piekļuves koda.

key: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
en: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
val: Bez piekļuves koda jūsu maku aizsargā tikai jūsu iPhone tālruņa bloķēšanas ekrāns. Ieslēdziet piekļuves kodu, lai pieprasītu autentifikāciju katru reizi, kad atverat Aperture, un lai izmantotu %@.

key: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
en: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
val: Pieprasīt %@ pirms katras no šīm darbībām. Ja tas neizdodas, varat atgriezties pie piekļuves koda.
